visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a close-up presentation of several sliced Korean egg sushi rolls arranged on a white ceramic plate with Korean calligraphy in the background. A hand wearing a clear plastic glove picks up one piece, showcasing the dense filling of shredded cabbage, yellow egg, orange carrot, and pink crab stick. (2) The scene shifts to a kitchen counter where three yellow eggs are cracked into a clear glass bowl, followed by small amounts of white salt and clear water being added. A silver fork is used to whisk the mixture until smooth, then it is poured through a fine-mesh metal strainer into another bowl to ensure a uniform texture. (3) A black non-stick frying pan with a Mickey Mouse pattern on the surface is heated, and a small amount of oil is wiped across it. The strained egg mixture is poured in, forming a thin yellow sheet that is cooked over low heat until the edges lift, showing a pale yellow, slightly bubbly surface. (4) The cooked egg sheets are removed, stacked, and shredded into thin strips using a sharp silver knife on a wooden cutting board, with the hands maintaining precise control. (5) On a bamboo rolling mat covered in plastic wrap, a sheet of dark green dried seaweed is placed. The creator meticulously layers shredded green cabbage, the yellow egg strips, pink crab sticks, and orange carrot strips in the center, finishing with a line of white mayonnaise squeezed from a tube. (6) Using the bamboo mat, the seaweed is tightly rolled into a cylinder, with the gloved hands applying firm pressure to ensure the roll remains compact and the ingredients are secure. (7) The completed roll, still wrapped in plastic, is sliced into even, bite-sized rounds with a large knife, revealing the colorful cross-section of the fresh vegetable and egg fillings. (8) The final sequence shows the sliced rolls being brushed with a clear, glossy oil and sprinkled with black sesame seeds, ending with a beauty shot of the finished dish on the decorative plate.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a bright, mid-tempo acoustic pop track featuring a strummed guitar and a clean drum beat. A male narrator introduces the recipe with a friendly, high-arousal tone. A soft 'thud' sound occurs as a plate is presented. (2) As the eggs are cracked, a sharp 'click-crack' sound is audible, followed by the metallic tinkling of a fork whisking against a glass bowl and the liquid splash of water being added. The narrator details the ingredient portions clearly. (3) A steady white-noise sizzling sound begins as the egg mixture hits the pan, lasting for several seconds. The narrator's pitch remains energetic, explaining the low-heat technique. A subtle 'whoosh' transition effect bridge to the next step. (4) Rhythmic, percussive 'thud-thud' sounds are layered over the music as the egg sheets are sliced on a wooden board. The narrator maintains a fast speech rate to match the visual editing. (5) The sound of plastic wrap rustling and the crisp crinkle of seaweed follow. A soft squelching sound is heard as mayonnaise is squeezed. The BGM remains consistent in volume and tempo. (6) A distinct woody friction sound occurs as the bamboo mat is rolled. The narrator explains the rolling method with rising intonation for emphasis. (7) Sharp, crisp 'slicing' sounds mark each cut of the knife through the roll. (8) The video concludes with a final 'ding' or sparkle sound effect as the finished dish is revealed, with the narrator signing off in a warm, satisfied tone.
